save_checkpoint: save a torch state dictionary to a checkpoint file in the specified directory
load_check_duplicates: load normalizer modules from a config file and warn on duplicate targets
load_from_config: load or fit normalizer modules from a config dictionary using a fit function
review_save_checkpoint: review the save_checkpoint function that serializes a state dict to a .pt file
refactor_load_from_config: refactor the _load_from_config function to support additional config keys for module creation
